scene_analysis.scene_overview: A narrow street in a European city lined with buildings on both sides. The street is paved with gray concrete and has a slight incline. The buildings are mostly beige with some having balconies with black railings and potted plants. There are people walking along the sidewalk and a few shops on the right side of the street. The sky is clear and blue.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings have a mix of beige and white facades with some having balconies with black railings and potted plants. Some have large windows and doors, while others have smaller ones. The buildings appear to be several stories tall.
